visualCharacteristics.purpose: review badge, star rating, score and review-count link; stars derive from the authored numeric score

contentPattern.structure: cells (any order): [badge image] [score, e.g. "(4.3 out of 5)"] [review count link, e.g. "1770 Car Reviews"]; optional key/value rows [score] [4.3], [max] [5], [count] [link], [badge] [image]. With intro-text, extra cells (heading, paragraphs) render beside the rating

reuseGuidance: Use for an aggregate review score. intro-text option places a heading and paragraphs beside the rating.
